data_usage.full: all generated tray-vibe log PSD points, modal log-FRF magnitudes, and flight tray/interface log PSD points
data_usage.peak_feature: hard observed peak/notch features compared to differentiable soft peak/notch forward-model features

feature_noise_assumptions.amplitude_noise: learned build/sensor scales plus fixed feature floors; flight amplitudes also include fixed 3 dB forcing variability

feature_sensitivity.note: Predicted features are soft peak/notch transfer-function features from the forward model, not natural frequencies.

qoi_interval_contract.reason: The acceleration PSD is expressed in g^2/Hz; integrating gives g RMS, commonly GRMS.
